title: Chapter 85 Hadro Gets Promoted
content:
Chapter 85 Hadro Gets Promoted

"Okay, Duan Wenxi, Suo Yong, you two will be responsible for arranging personnel, setting up tailor shops, breeding farms and reclaiming farmland. Now that we have the corresponding personnel, we must let them play to their strengths."

"Yes, Lord."

"Baili Liang, Guli Ji, you two, assist Hua Tianxiong, go to the outside of Wana Village, kill wild beasts, and upgrade."

"Yes, Lord." The three immediately bowed.

"Hua Tianxiong, go to Matar and distribute equipment to your militia team to form combat effectiveness as soon as possible."

"Matar, you hurry up and make more arrows, the more the better!"

After everyone left, Wang Shuo said to Ayubu: "Abu, you take the remaining members of the Swift Scout Cavalry Team to the ancient battlefield to earn merit points."

"Yes, Lord."

"Remember, you must pay attention to safety, and you must bring back all my subordinates." Wang Shuo took a look at his subordinates who had reached level 10 or above, and he was very satisfied.

This is the capital for his survival.

Guliji is already 100% loyal. Wang Shuo sent her to Hua Tianxiong's militia team, firstly to be responsible for security, and secondly to monitor.

In the empty hall, there was still a maid Xiaona left. Wang Shuo thought about it and asked her to prepare some tea.

Then, he took out Hadro's summoning scroll.

In the courtyard, Hadro walked out of the portal.

"Long time no see, my dear lord." Hadro gave Wang Shuo a big hug.

"What's the matter? You are so happy?" Wang Shuo also smiled.

"Thanks to the lord, I got promoted! Haha..." Hadro said with a smile.

"Huh?" Wang Shuo said with some surprise, "Congratulations! Let's go inside to have some tea and talk slowly."

After the two exchanged greetings for a while.

It turned out that Hadro was promoted from a peddler to an agent.

Although he was only a first-level agent, he was qualified to transfer materials from the branch.

With the increase in authority, the number and types of items that can be sold have been greatly improved.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo thought of Li Youcai in Nanshan Market, so he asked: "Do you know a man named Li Youcai?"

Hadlo thought for a while, then said: "I seem to have some impression. He seems to be a core member of the Li Chamber of Commerce and the sales champion last year."

"Although I have never seen this person, I have heard of some of his deeds,..."

So that's it!

Wang Shuo was thoughtful.

"Lord, you should be facing the first wave of beasts now!"

Wang Shuo nodded: "That's right."

"I made a special trip this time and prepared a lot of good things for you." Hadlo showed his signature smile.

Wang Shuo's mouth twitched. It seems that he will bleed again this time, but as long as he can buy good things, everything is worth it.

"Oh? If you want to make money from me, let me see what good things you brought!" Wang Shuo also showed a smile on his face.

"How can you say you're making money when you're doing business? We're helping each other and developing together."

Wang Shuo stopped being polite and said with a smile, "Hurry up and take out your good stuff so I can see it!"

Hadro took out a black ball the size of an egg from his backpack and said to Wang Shuo, "Lord, please look, this thing is called 'Thunderbolt', it can cause a lot of damage to enemies within the area."
